# Helvety Auth

> Passwordless Helvety Auth for email verification and passkey flows across Tasks, Contacts, Notes, and Links. After email verification on a browser, trusted devices may start at passkey sign-in without re-entering email. Engineered, designed and made in Switzerland.

## Canonical URL
- [Sign In](https://helvety.com/auth/login): Primary sign-in page (entry step resolved server-side, including trusted-device passkey-first)

## Crawling And Indexing
- Auth routes are intended not to be indexed.
- These routes are not intended as crawl targets and use noindex metadata. The sign-in route is publicly reachable by design, while session-based checks apply where required.

## Chromium Extension (side panel)
- Sign-in and unlock use `/auth/api/extension/otp/*` and Bearer passkey routes on this host.
- OTP verify returns server-HMAC `weekly_proof` for `helvety_extension_weekly_proof` storage; the extension does not receive the web HttpOnly `helvety_device_trust` cookie.
